text: I can set connect, time-to-first-token, stream-idle and total timeouts for an LLM call from stated assumptions about decode speed and output length.
I can classify LLM API errors into retry, don't retry and repair, and multiply out the worst-case retry amplification of a stack with SDK, wrapper and failover retries.
I can design provider failover behind a per-provider circuit breaker and list the prompt, eval, quota and data-agreement work it needs beforehand.
I can write a degradation ladder for an AI feature and say which signal moves traffic down each rung.
I can build a parse, schema-validate, semantic-check and bounded repair-retry pipeline, and estimate its extra token cost.
